requirements.summary: Final checks identify RHEL 7.9, a valid Nginx configuration with `listen 6700`, and an active service. The lifecycle snapshot directly shows Nginx listening on all interfaces at TCP 6700.

requirements.requirement: An HTTP request to `/` on node1 TCP port 6700 returns a successful response.
requirements.summary: Direct requests to node1's managed address, 10.100.124.10:6700, returned HTTP 200 with the Nginx welcome page; the result was confirmed again in the final verification.

overall_summary: The task is satisfied: Nginx is running on node1 and directly demonstrated an HTTP 200 response at `/` over TCP port 6700.
limitations: Package-manager health checks timed out both before and after execution, so overall package consistency could not be independently assessed.
The HTTP request originated on node1 against its managed IP; no request from a separate host was captured.
